sources.title: Meet Qwable: The Free Local Model That Thinks Like Claude Fable
sources.snippet: Qwable without a conscience Qwable is a censored model. After all, both Qwen and Claude are. But Qwen, as the base model, is open source, and can be manipulated and tweaked. Huihui-ai, an open-source contributor known for uncensored GGUF releases, took Qwable and applied a process called abliteration to produce Huihui-Qwable-3.6-27b-abliterated.
